description:
Consider a process for purchasing items from an online shop.
The user starts an order by logging in to their account.
Then, the user simultaneously selects the items to purchase and sets a payment method.
Afterward, the user either pays or completes an installment agreement.
After selecting the items, the user chooses between multiple options for a free reward.
Since the reward value depends on the purchase value, this step is done after selecting the items, but it is independent of the payment activities.
Finally, the items are delivered.
The user has the right to return items for exchange.
Every time items are returned, a new delivery is made.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OnlineShopPurchase" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop-purchase">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShopPurchase" name="Online Shop Purchase" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderStarted" name="Order started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log in to account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Login</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_SetupSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Setup_Split" name="Select items and set payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Login_SetupSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SetupSplit_SelectItems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SetupSplit_SetPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectItems" name="Select items to purchase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SetupSplit_SelectItems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectItems_ChooseReward</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseReward" name="Choose free reward option">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectItems_ChooseReward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseReward_FinalJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPaymentMethod" name="Set payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SetupSplit_SetPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SetPayment_PaymentSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Split" name="Payment option">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SetPayment_PaymentSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentSplit_Pay</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentSplit_Installment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Pay" name="Pay">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentSplit_Pay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Pay_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteInstallment" name="Complete installment agreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentSplit_Installment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Installment_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Pay_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Installment_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentMerge_FinalJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Final_Join" name="Setup branches done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseReward_FinalJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentMerge_FinalJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalJoin_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delivery_Merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalJoin_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnItems_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeliveryMerge_Deliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverItems" name="Deliver items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeliveryMerge_Deliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deliver_ReturnSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Return_Split" name="Items returned?" default="Flow_NoReturn_End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deliver_ReturnSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnSplit_ReturnItems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoReturn_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return items for exchange">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnSplit_ReturnItems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnItems_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoReturn_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Login" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderStarted" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_SetupSplit" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetupSplit_SelectItems" sourceRef="Gateway_Setup_Split" targetRef="Task_SelectItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetupSplit_SetPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_Setup_Split" targetRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectItems_ChooseReward" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Task_ChooseReward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseReward_FinalJoin" sourceRef="Task_ChooseReward" targetRef="Gateway_Final_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetPayment_PaymentSplit" sourceRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentSplit_Pay" name="Pay" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentSplit_Installment" name="Installment agreement" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_CompleteInstallment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pay_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Installment_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_CompleteInstallment" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMerge_FinalJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Final_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalJoin_DeliveryMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_Final_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryMerge_Deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_ReturnSplit" sourceRef="Task_DeliverItems" targetRef="Gateway_Return_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnSplit_ReturnItems" name="Items returned" sourceRef="Gateway_Return_Split" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnItems_DeliveryMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoReturn_End" name="No return" sourceRef="Gateway_Return_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
